what: The Round builder cannot be scrolled by touch, and its Start button sits below the screen on common phones. `.sheet{touch-action:none}` (line 466) blocks touch panning on the sheet, which is itself the scroll container (`.sheet{max-height:86vh;overflow:auto}`, line 524). On 360×640 and 375×667 (iPhone SE), even a brand-new user's 6-leg sheet puts #rbBuild at y≈814 on a 640/667 px screen. With a weak leg and due patterns (8 legs) it is off-screen at 390×844 too. On a phone you cannot start the Round, the app's main action.
evidence: Measured #rbBuild bottom: 360×640 → 814; 375×667 → 817; 390×844 with 8 legs → 952. Touch swipe via CDP Input.dispatchTouchEvent on the sheet: scrollTop stays 0. After setting style.touchAction='pan-y' the same swipe scrolls 124 px. Page-body swipe (control) scrolls 471 px. Screenshot /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T01-builder-360x640.png
fix: Set `.sheet{touch-action:pan-y}`, and keep the swipe-to-close only on .sheet-grab, or only when scrollTop===0. Make the Start/Cancel row a sticky footer (`position:sticky;bottom:0;background:var(--surface)`) so the primary action is always visible.

what: On one screen the Round has three different lengths and two different leg lists. A new user's hero lists 6 legs, 'about 24 minutes'. Today's plan says 'The Round · 25 min'. Tapping Start opens the builder with only 3 legs ticked, 'Start · 14 min', because roundCap() defaults to 15 while SLOT_MIN.free is 25. With due patterns and a weak step: hero 29 min with 7 legs (no weak leg), plan 25 min, builder 15 min with 8 legs on offer.
evidence: Fresh state at 390×844: hero 'about 24 minutes', plan 'The Round 25 min', builder ticks [0,1,1,1,0,0], 'Start · 14 min'. Seeded state: hero 29 min / 7 legs; builder 8 legs, 'Start · 15 min'. Shots /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T01-first-phone.png, /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T01-builder-phone.png
fix: Use one source of truth. Build the default selection once (presetLegs(roundCatalog(), roundCap())), show exactly those legs and that total in the hero, and pass the same minutes to the plan item. Make roundCap() default to SLOT_MIN[slot] (25 on a free day), not 15.

what: On a night-shift day the plan card says 'Night shift: rest…', but the hero still says 'One composed session · about 24 minutes' with 'Start the Round'. Tapping Start preselects 'Five step-by-step gases · 8 min', because roundCap() returns 0 and presetLegs always keeps the first leg. Two cards give opposite advice.
evidence: Served on localhost, G.tok set, G.planDays[today]={shift:{code:'N',overnight:true}}: plan '0/1 · about 3 min · night shift', hero unchanged, builder checked 000100, 'Start · 8 min'. Shot /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T01-night-today.png
fix: When slotFor(today())==='tough': change the hero to 'Night shift · Buffer rests today', make the button secondary ('Do a Round anyway'), and have presetLegs(cat,0) return [] (or a single 'Five-second read' leg) so the builder opens empty. Do the same light-touch copy for 'postnight'.

what: Skipping every leg counts as a finished Round. It gives +40 XP, sets lastRound, increments roundsDone, starts the streak, plays confetti and shows the 'Round complete' hero, all without answering a single question.
evidence: Fresh state: Start the Round → Start · 14 min → press 'Skip leg' 3 times. Result: S.lastRound='2026-11-13', roundsDone=1, xp=40, streak()=1, hero 'ROUND COMPLETE · Done for today.'
fix: Track per-leg outcome (ROUND.legs[i].skipped=true). In roundFinish, award the bonus, set lastRound and call touchDay only if at least one leg was actually done (e.g. ≥ half). Otherwise toast 'Round ended. Nothing was finished, so today is still open.'

what: The 'Go' button on the Round bar restarts the current leg, which throws away the answers already given in it. It is shown during the leg, next to 'Skip leg', so it is easy to tap.
evidence: Round leg 1 (gym): answer 2 items (SS.res.length=2), tap Go → SS.res.length=0, a fresh 5-sum gym.
fix: Show 'Go' only when VIEW is not already the leg's view, and call it 'Resume'. In roundGo, if SS && SS.round && !SS.done && the leg is a session, just go('session') instead of startSession again. Do the same for est/web/teach (only navigate).

where: popstate / route (Back from things opened on Today)
what: Back after a cold start does nothing on the first press. The PWA starts at './' with no hash. Opening a lesson (hook link, Next lesson), the Interpreter, a speed drill (plan item) or a Round's concept/estimate/shift/teach leg, then pressing Back, only removes the hash and leaves the same screen up. A second Back exits the app.
evidence: about:blank → buffer-4.9.0.html (no hash) → tap hook 'Older adults →' (#l-sp-elder, lesson). Back → URL '' but VIEW still 'lesson'. Back again → about:blank (app closed). Same for [data-q=interp], [data-pl=1] (#speed), Round legs web/est/scen/teach. Starting from '#today' the first Back correctly returns to Today.
fix: In boot(), normalise the URL first: `if(!location.hash)history.replaceState(null,'','#today')` before route(). Also in route(), treat an empty hash as 'today' even when first===false: `if(!h){if(VIEW!=='today')go('today',true);return;}`.

what: A session started from Today (Gas of the day 'Read it step by step', Weak-spot gym, a mastery tile, Review now, the quick tiles) ends on Practice when you press Back or ✕ before answering. Today was where you came from.
evidence: #today → #gotdGo → Back → '#practice practice'. Same for the Weak spot 'Compensation gym' and .mt[data-k].
fix: Record the origin view in startSession (SS.from=VIEW==='session'?SS&&SS.from:VIEW) and, in sExit and the summary's buttons, go(SS.from||'practice').

what: The builder sheet is not keyboard-usable as a dialog. Esc does not close it (the generic sheet() has an Esc handler, openRoundBuilder does not). Focus stays on #tRound behind the scrim, so Tab moves through the Today page underneath. There is no aria-modal. After Cancel, focus falls to <body>.
evidence: Desktop 1280×800: focus #tRound, Enter → sheet open, activeElement=tRound; Tab → 'OUTSIDE The Round' (plan button); Escape → sheet still open; Cancel → activeElement BODY.
fix: Add role=dialog aria-modal=true aria-labelledby. On open, focus the first checkbox (or the Start button). Trap Tab inside .sheet, close on Escape (and on Back, see the next finding), and on close return focus to #tRound.

what: Pressing Android/browser Back while the Round builder is open closes the whole app instead of the sheet.
evidence: #today fresh → tap Start the Round → go_back() → about:blank.
fix: When the sheet opens, history.pushState({sheet:1},''). On popstate with a sheet open, close it, and on Cancel/Start call history.back() to consume the entry. Apply the same to the hand-kit sheet() in ui1.js.

what: A brand-new user gets no welcome and no orientation. Lesson 1 ('How you will learn blood gases · Start here') is the 6th block down, under the Round, the plan, the quick tiles, the Gas of the day, the hook and the Citrus card. The Round, the first thing offered, is aimed at someone who already reads gases: 'Concept of the day: Carbonic anhydrase' and 'Five step-by-step gases' at the default level 4 (DEF2.lvl:4, Full read).
evidence: localStorage.clear(), 390×844: order hero → plan → quick → gotd → hook → citrus → Next lesson tile. Shot /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T01-first-phone.png. e1.js DEF2 lvl:4.
fix: When Object.keys(S.done).length===0 && !S.read: replace the hero with a 'Start here' card (lesson 1 + a 2-line description of Today/Round/plan + a units choice mmHg/kPa), and hide or collapse the mastery grid and the Gas of the day ('after your first lesson'). Consider DEF2.lvl:1 or asking 'Have you read gases before?' on first open.

what: On a free day with 2 or more patterns due, 'Review N due patterns' is dropped from Today's plan by the cap filter (25 + 6 > 30), while the due banner right below says '15 patterns due'. The Round covers at most 4 of them.
evidence: Seeded 15 due: plan = 'The Round / Real printouts / Log a real gas' only. Due banner '15 patterns due for review'. Round leg 'Review 4 due patterns'.
fix: Exempt 'due' from the cap like 'round' (or count the Round's due leg as covering min(4,due), and add 'Review the other N' only when due>4). Say 'Round includes 4 of 15 due' on the Round line.

what: The 'Weekly review' item for Sunday/Monday is pushed after the Round (25) and the speed drill (4), so the cap filter (sum+5 > 30) always drops it before the Round is done. It is never shown on a free day. When it is shown, done is hard-coded false, so it can never tick.
evidence: Clock 2026-11-15 10:00 and 2026-11-16 10:00 (Asia/Riyadh), fresh state: plan = 'The Round / Five-second read|Pattern flash / Log a real gas'. No Weekly review.
fix: Put the weekly item before the speed drill, and exempt it from the cap. Mark it done when S.ui.weekly===isoWeek. Also consider the user's locale week: in Saudi Arabia the week starts on Sunday and the weekend is Friday–Saturday, so make the review day a setting.

what: The speed drill of the day rotates on the UTC day (Math.floor(Date.now()/864e5)), not the local day used everywhere else (dayNum()). In Riyadh the plan's drill changes at 03:00, not at midnight. Between 00:00 and 03:00 the Gas of the day/concept (local) and the drill (UTC) belong to different days.
evidence: Clock 13/11 02:00 +03:00 → drill 'Pattern flash'; 04:59 same day → 'Real printouts'. dayNum()=20770 vs UTC 20769.
fix: Use dayNum() (ui1.js) instead of Math.floor(Date.now()/864e5).

what: During a second Round on the same day, the hero says 'ROUND COMPLETE · Done for today. Anything else is a bonus.' while also showing 'Continue the Round', Stop and the in-progress leg list. The doneToday check wins over inRound.
evidence: Finish a Round, then 'Another Round' → Start → go('today'). Shot /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T01-today-secondround-phone.png
fix: Check inRound first: tag 'Round in progress', h2 'Leg i of n · <current label>'. Use doneToday only when !inRound (maybe 'Bonus Round in progress').

what: After a Round is complete, the hero lists today's full default plan (all 6–8 legs with minutes), not the legs actually done. It looks like a to-do list that still needs doing.
evidence: Finish a 3-leg Round → hero shows Concept/Gym/Estimates/Steps/Shift/Teach with min. Shot /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T01-today-rounddone-phone.png
fix: Store the finished legs (S.lastRoundLegs) and show them ticked with the real time, or collapse the hero to one line: 'Round done · 3 legs · 12 min · +40'.

what: In a Round in progress, the hero leg list marks done legs but not the current one, and none of the rows can be tapped. You cannot jump to or skip a specific leg from Today.
evidence: Round leg 1 of 3: no .cur class; li elements are not buttons.
fix: Add class 'cur' (accent left border) to li i===ROUND.i, and make each future leg a button that sets ROUND.i and calls roundGo (with confirm).

what: The plan's Round line ignores Round state. While a Round is in progress it still says 'The Round'. After it is done it says '✓ The Round is done · 25 min' whatever the real time was (a 1-minute or 40-minute Round both show 25).
evidence: Round in progress → plan 'The Round 25 min'. Done in 1 min → '✓ The Round is done 25 min'.
fix: Label 'Continue the Round (leg i/n)' when ROUND exists. When done, show the real minutes from S.lastRoundMin (store it in roundFinish).

what: The builder always says 'Your weakest step comes first.', even when there is no weak leg (a new user, or fewer than 3 attempts per step). With a Citrus plan whose minutes are missing it shows 'Citrus planned  min.'
evidence: Fresh state: note shown, no 'Weakest step' row. G.plan={status:'none'} → 'Citrus planned  min.'
fix: Show the weak-step sentence only when weakLeg() is not null. Show the Citrus sentence only when +G.plan.minutes>0 and G.plan.status==='accepted'. Say 'capped at N min for today's shift' when the slot reduced it.

what: When the weakest step is Compensation, the catalogue has both 'Weakest step: Compensation' (runs gym n:5) and 'Five compensation sums' (gym n:5). The default and Standard presets tick both, so the Round runs two identical gym sets.
evidence: Seeded comp 40%: builder default checked [weak, due, concept, gym]; Standard 25 → weak + due + gym + est + steps.
fix: When wl.c==='comp', drop the 'gym' leg from roundPlan (or turn the weak leg into a targeted step-by-step on compensation-heavy kinds).

what: The presets give no feedback. There is no pressed state, and for a new user 'Standard 25' and 'Everything' select the same 24 minutes, so the buttons look broken. 'Quick 10' picks 'Concept + Five step-by-step gases', with no gym, because the priority order is greedy.
evidence: Fresh: Quick 10 → [1,0,0,1,0,0] 10 min; Standard 25 → all 6, 24 min; Everything → all 6, 24 min.
fix: Mark the active preset with aria-pressed. Hide 'Everything' when it equals Standard. For Quick 10, prefer a mix (e.g. gym 3 + est 3 + concept 2 = 8, or weak + due).

what: Drive merge checks `a.round.date===today()`, but a Round is saved with `day`, not `date` (ui5.js line 28). Every Drive merge therefore sets o.round=null. If the app reloads after a sync, an in-progress Round is lost.
evidence: ui5.js: ROUND={legs,i,t0,xp0,day:today()}; hub.js line 104 uses .date. boot() restores only S.round.day===today().
fix: Use `.day` in mergeStates (prefer the round with higher i).

what: The plan test is always true when a plan object exists, because of precedence: `(G.plan&&G.plan.status!=='none'||G.plan)`. A block with status 'none' shows 'Citrus suggests today · 25 min', with 25 made up as a default.
evidence: G.plan={status:'none'} → 'Citrus suggests today · 25 min.'
fix: Use `G.plan&&G.plan.status!=='none'`. Do not default minutes to 25: omit the minutes when they are absent.

what: On the day after a night shift the plan card says 'after a night' and caps at 10 min, but the Citrus line says nothing about why ('No block from Citrus yet today.'). The shift sentence only appears when today itself has a shift.
evidence: G.planDays[yesterday]={shift:{code:'N'}} → Citrus line 'No block from Citrus yet today.'
fix: Add 'After last night's shift · kept light (10 min).' when slot==='postnight', and 'Night tonight · short Round' for 'before'.

what: The 'Step by step' tile says '10 gases' regardless of the Gases per session setting (S.sessLen 5/10/20).
evidence: S.sessLen=5 → tile still '10 gases, marked step by step'.
fix: Use S.sessLen in the tile text, as MODS_META does on Practice.

what: The Gas of the day card does not change after you have read it (S.ui.gotd is set in ui2.js but never read), and it is not on Today's plan. 'Just show me' cannot be hidden again and gives only the label, the cause and the compensation, with no anion gap or Δ ratio reasoning for a HAGMA + NAGMA gas.
evidence: Set S.ui.gotd=today() → card unchanged. Show → 'HAGMA + NAGMA · Diarrhoea with AKI and dehydration. Appropriate respiratory compensation.'
fix: When S.ui.gotd===today(), show '✓ Read today · your score' and change the button to 'Review it'. Make 'Just show me' a toggle and include the gap (corrected) and Δ ratio lines from g.o.steps. Optionally add 'Gas of the day' as a 2-min plan item.

where: RENDER.today Gas of the day prompt
what: 'Read it in your head first: pH, partner, proof, the rest.' uses a mnemonic that appears only as one lesson hook (c3.js line 366). It does not match the six-step read the app teaches on Learn (Real? · pH · System · Compensation · Gaps · Oxygen), and it skips the consistency check.
evidence: ui1.js line 137 vs METHOD in ui1.js line 155.
fix: Use the app's method: 'Read it in your head first: real? · pH · system · compensation · gaps · oxygen.'

what: 'One composed session · about 24 minutes': 'composed' is jargon. On phones the line wraps with '·' at the start of the second line.
evidence: Shot /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T01-first-phone.png (line 2 starts with '· about 24 minutes').
fix: 'Today's Round · about 24 min' as the h2, or put the minutes in the eyebrow ('TODAY'S ROUND · 24 MIN') with an h2 like 'Six short legs, one sitting'. Use a non-breaking space before '·'.

what: Small primary buttons are 10px. In the pixel skin that is the pixel font, but in the clinical skin it is Atkinson at 10px, much smaller than the 13.76px secondary button next to it. This affects plan items (including the long night-shift sentence), 'Read it step by step', 'Review now' and weak-spot buttons.
evidence: Computed: clinical #gotdGo 10px vs #gotdShow 13.76px; [data-pl=0] 10px. Shot /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T01-today-clinical-light-tablet.png
fix: Add `html[data-skin=clinical] .btn.primary.small{font-size:.86rem}`. In both skins, use the regular font for plan rows (.planl .btn.primary{font-family:inherit;font-size:.86rem}), because they are sentences, not labels.

what: Plan rows have ragged right edges: the button width depends on the width of the minutes label ('25 min' vs '4 min' vs '1 min'). On desktop the full-width bars with tiny left-aligned text look like progress bars.
evidence: Desktop shot /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T01-first-desk.png (buttons end at x≈1075/1083/1086).
fix: Give `.planl li small{min-width:4.5em;text-align:right}`. On ≥820px, cap the plan width or lay the items out as a numbered checklist with the minutes inside the row.

what: In the dark theme, the Round bar is a cream (var(--ink)) slab with dark text, the only light surface on a dark screen. It holds three buttons ('Go', 'Skip leg', '✕') plus the label, and takes ~115px on a phone above the content. '✕' stops the whole Round without confirmation, right next to 'Skip leg'.
evidence: Shot /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T01-round-leg1-phone.png
fix: Use var(--surface-2) with an accent top border in dark. Collapse to one line on phones (pips + label + ⋯ menu holding Skip/Stop). Ask to confirm Stop, or offer Undo in the toast.

what: The builder uses native checkboxes in the browser's default blue, which clash with the orange accent in both skins. The sheet title 'Build today's Round' is the 10px muted pixel label, smaller than the row text.
evidence: Shots /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T01-builder-phone.png, /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T01-builder-desk.png
fix: Add `.sheet input[type=checkbox]{accent-color:var(--accent);width:22px;height:22px}` and make the sheet title an h2 at about 18px.

what: 'Late shift.' between 00:00 and 04:59 assumes work. With Citrus shift data the app knows whether the user is on a night shift.
evidence: Clock 02:00 → 'Late shift.'
fix: Use 'Up late.' by default, and 'Night shift.' only when slotFor(today())==='tough'. Optionally add the name of today's shift from Citrus to the eyebrow.

what: 'Compensation · 50% over your last attempts.' does not say how many attempts; stepAcc uses the last up to 20.
evidence: Seeded comp h length 10 → '50% over your last attempts'.
fix: 'Compensation · 5 of your last 10 right.' using the h slice.

what: Plan items show the bare drill name ('Real printouts', 'Pattern flash', 'Handover line'), which does not say what you will do.
evidence: Fresh plan: 'Real printouts · 4 min'.
fix: Prefix it: 'Speed drill: real printouts (10)', and for 'Log a real gas from your day' add '(no names or IDs)' as a reminder.

what: Roadmap says 'Today's plan as home', but the plan is a secondary card under a large Round hero that duplicates it. There are three 'start the Round' buttons on screen at once (hero, plan, Round bar).
evidence: First-run shot.
fix: Merge the hero and the plan: one 'Today' card with the Round as the first plan row (expandable to its legs), then due, case, drill, log. A single primary button: 'Start: <next undone item>'.

what: Back from any tab other than Today leaves the app, because tab switches use replaceState. On Android it is normal for Back to go to Home first.
evidence: #today → Learn tab → Back → about:blank.
fix: When leaving Today for a top-level tab, pushState once (as SUBNAV does), so Back from Learn/Labs/Practice/Progress returns to Today, and only Back on Today exits.

what: 15 'new' tiles take more than half the phone screen for a new user and carry no information until something has been read.
evidence: First-run phone shot: grid from y≈1400 to 2900 px of 2921.
fix: For new users show a single line ('15 patterns · read your first gas to start the map'). Collapse the grid behind 'Show all' on phones.

what: The Gas of the day has no 'streak' or comparison; 'the same gas for everyone' is only true within one time zone, because the seed is the local day.
evidence: withSeed(dayNum()*7919).
fix: Show your own past Gas-of-the-day results (last 7 days ✓/✗) and say 'the same gas for every Buffer user today' only if you seed by UTC date.
